llm_response.reason: The website displays classic phishing and scam characteristics: unusually low prices ('Cheap Courier Massive Discount'), sense of urgency and shipment tracking, use of pre-filled personal data in the URL, prompts for additional contact/payment info, one outbound hyperlink to an unrelated domain, lack of legitimate company/contact/payment/privacy information, and the spoofed appearance of shipping/service flow. This strongly indicates a fake online shopping or package delivery scam.
